tour_ekpp_dashboard_0_content: Quick overview of club activity levels, current member count, and recent achievements.
tour_ekpp_dashboard_1_content: List of club member assignments. Submit tasks to earn merit points and monitor team progress.
tour_ekpp_laporan_0_content: Complete archive of your club's monthly reports. Upload official documents like Financial Statements or Meeting Minutes for JPP review.
tour_ekpp_laporan_1_content: Each card represents one monthly report. Click to view, update, or auto-generate professional report PDFs.
tour_ekpp_semakan_0_content: JPP executive vault. All monthly reports submitted by clubs must be verified for accuracy before approval.
tour_exco_content: Official JPP Exco Modules. Explore dedicated services across each Student Representative Council portfolio.
tour_fab_content: Last and most important! This is the Smart Navigation. If you ever get lost on any page, tap this (+) button for quick shortcuts.
tour_kebajikan_dashboard_0_content: Welcome to the student welfare and complaint center. Report campus facility issues and monitor management follow-up actions.
tour_kebajikan_dashboard_1_content: Monitor facility health in real time. See how many reports have been resolved by maintenance teams.
tour_kebajikan_submit_0_content: Report damaged campus facilities here. Fill in accurate details so maintenance teams can respond immediately.
tour_kebajikan_submit_1_content: Ensure you select the right location and category so this report reaches the correct department (e.g., Development or Hostel).
tour_kebajikan_submit_2_content: Swift action requires clear evidence. Upload photos of the damaged area to facilitate investigation.
tour_kebajikan_tickets_0_content: Monitor all complaints you have submitted. Track current statuses and communicate directly with JPP Excos.
tour_kebajikan_tickets_1_content: Your complaint will not be overlooked! Check status updates and chat directly with JPP Excos to follow up.
tour_keusahawanan_content: PolyMart. A dedicated space for students to start micro-businesses, advertise merchandise, and run campus e-Commerce.
tour_keusahawanan_dashboard_0_content: The central hub for your enterprise. Monitor finances, sales performance, and inventory status in one place.
tour_keusahawanan_dashboard_1_content: Running more than one venture? Use this switcher to manage different business profiles.
tour_keusahawanan_dashboard_2_content: Real-time financial tracking. View total revenue generated this month at a glance.
tour_keusahawanan_dashboard_3_content: Analyze customer purchasing trends over the past 30 days to optimize your marketing strategy.
tour_keusahawanan_dashboard_4_content: The system automatically alerts you when inventory is running low. Never miss a sales opportunity!
tour_keusahawanan_order_0_content: Your cashier cash register system. Add items, scan PolyMart customer QRs, and calculate totals automatically.
tour_keusahawanan_order_1_content: Select payment methods (Cash, QR, Online) and confirm transactions. Change is computed automatically.
tour_keusahawanan_product_0_content: Add new inventory. Set prices, upload attractive photos, and assign barcode scanning.
tour_keusahawanan_product_1_content: Filter and manage products by category. Check remaining stock and update prices quickly.
tour_keusahawanan_product_2_content: Track inventory levels live. The system highlights items when stock runs low.
tour_keusahawanan_urus_0_content: Full control panel for your business. Each tab covers a critical aspect — from brand identity to staff and premium features.
tour_keusahawanan_urus_1_content: List employees, approve new staff access, and manage POS Terminal permissions.
tour_keusahawanan_urus_2_content: Activate premium features such as Discount Coupons and Cash Register Sessions to tightly manage cashflow.
tour_nav_desktop: In this sidebar, you can navigate to other clubs, activity schedule, reports, and club settings.
tour_nav_mobile: Open this menu to access the club list, activity schedule, and club reports.
tour_polymaps_page_0_content: Welcome to the POLISAS mapping system! Find buildings, lecture halls, hostels, or nearby facilities via GPS.
tour_polymaps_page_1_content: Search quickly. Enter building, hall, or hostel names, and our mapping engine will pinpoint exact campus locations.
tour_polymaps_page_2_content: Urgent need? Access smart filters to scan cafeterias, musollas, or restrooms within nearest GPS radius.
tour_polymart_layout_0_content: Welcome to the campus e-Commerce hub! Support fellow student entrepreneurs by purchasing delicious food, beverages, and unique items.
tour_polymart_layout_1_content: Filter products by category quickly to find what you need without endless scrolling.
tour_polymart_layout_2_content: All selected items are collected here. Confirm orders and pay with Cash, QR Pay, or online banking.
tour_polymart_layout_3_content: For Merchants: Access sales management and handle customer orders directly from this tab.
tour_polymart_layout_4_content: Use the bottom menu bar to check current order status, purchase history, or return to homepage.
tour_polyrent_page_0_content: Exclusive room rental platform for POLISAS students. Find suitable rooms, save favorites, and contact landlords directly within the app.
tour_polyrent_page_1_content: Type area or street names (e.g., "Beserah", "Balok") to filter rental listings in real time.
tour_polyrent_page_2_content: "House Listings" — landlords listing vacant rooms. "Student Seeking" — students looking for housemates or rooms.
tour_polyrent_page_3_content: Filter listings by gender preference (Male / Female / Mixed), or tap ❤️ to view all your saved favorites.
tour_polyrent_page_4_content: Tap any card to view full details — photos, amenities, distance to POLISAS, and landlord contact information.
tour_polyrent_page_5_content: Tap the heart icon to save listings. Your saved list remains even after closing the app.
tour_polyrent_page_6_content: Have a vacant room? Create an ad in 3 minutes. Set prices, upload photos, and enable in-app chat for students to reach you directly.
tour_polyrent_page_7_content: Unsure about affordability? Use this calculator to easily estimate rental budget, utilities, and upfront deposits.
tour_polyrent_page_8_content: Open the menu to manage published listings, update room vacancies, or close filled advertisements.
tour_polyrent_page_9_content: Tutorial complete. If you ever need help again, tap this (?) button to replay this guide.
tour_polytask_board_0_content: Welcome to PolyTask! An exclusive freelance platform for POLISAS students. Create gigs, receive bids, and earn extra income.
tour_polytask_board_1_content: Explore local opportunities. Browse gig requests aligned with your skillset to boost the campus micro-economy.
tour_polytask_myjobs_0_content: This page shows all tasks you have posted. Monitor status and interact with taskers who placed bids.
tour_portal_content: Welcome to the Official JPP POLISAS Super App Portal. Access your profile, theme settings, and notifications here.
tour_portal_main_0_content: Welcome! This smart platform is specially designed to connect you with all campus amenities. Let's explore the core features in 30 seconds.
tour_portal_main_10_content: Finally, if you want to replay this tutorial on any page, just tap this (?) button.
tour_portal_main_1_content: Customize your identity. Change your display name, update profile photo, reset password, or sign out securely here.
tour_portal_main_2_content: Fast access to on-demand services. From room reservations to printing services, everything at your fingertips.
tour_portal_main_3_content: Need to report facility damage or require student welfare fund support? Submit your official complaint directly to the management panel.
tour_portal_main_4_content: Collect merit points with ease! Just scan the QR code whenever you attend official campus activities or events.
tour_portal_main_5_content: Never miss an important date. Check the holiday list, exam schedules, and centralized event calendars directly.
tour_portal_main_6_content: Join clubs and societies! If you are part of club management, all activity and member administration starts here.
tour_portal_main_7_content: Start earning income. Dedicated space for campus commerce, promoting student businesses, and e-Commerce.
tour_portal_main_8_content: Your digital achievement portfolio. Track your CGPA trend, redeem merit points, and view verified awards.
tour_portal_main_9_content: Feeling lost? Tap this plus (+) button to summon the quick action menu. Access all systems anytime.
tour_services_content: Smart campus service grid. Quick access to Welfare Complaints, KAMSIS Hostel Checking, and PolyMart.
tour_settings_page_0_content: Keep your profile updated. Upload your latest photo and verify essential info.
tour_settings_page_1_content: Important: Always log out of the system when using public devices or lab computers for your account security.
tour_stats_content: These are quick metrics. You can view pending tasks count, active members count, and current club programs.
tour_tasks_content: This section shows committee member tasks or your tasks (for Regular Members). You can submit tasks here to earn Merit!
tour_welcome_content: Welcome to the Clubs & Societies Dashboard! This space lets you monitor activities, manage member tasks, and view your club statistics.
